item.title: PHOTOS: OKCFD K9 tests out new safety gear
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY (KFOR) - One of the Oklahoma City Fire Department's K9s recently tested out new safety gear. K9 Dino tested out the new gear to help him work safely in every environment. Pictures posted to OKCFD's social media show Dino wearing new eye and feet protection. "Dino is geared up," said OKCFD. "Always ready [...]

item.title: Oklahoma Supreme Court unanimously protects tribal hunting, fishing rights
item.description: Oklahoma Attorney General Gentner Drummond says the Oklahoma Supreme Court announced on Monday its unanimous reinforcement of his legal opinion protecting tribal members' right to hunt and fish on their reservations.

item.title: Thunder unveil official new arena name
item.description: Just as the dust settles on the tearing down of the Incomparable Myriad, the future appears. The new arena coming to Oklahoma City has its name.

item.title: Langston seeks to make history in NAIA Championship finals
item.description: The Langston Lions are set to play for the NAIA Championship title tonight at 7:00 p.m. after advancing to the championship game with a 72-69 OT victory over #3 Ave Maria.

item.title: OK leaders discuss proposed structural changes at the Department of Mental Health
item.description: State health leaders say Oklahoma's mental health department is facing a growing budget crisis, and they're working to address it.

item.title: Oklahoma agrees to share private voter data with DOJ in settlement
item.description: State Attorney General Gentner Drummond announced on Tuesday that a settlement has been reached in the lawsuit filed by the U.S. Department of Justice against the Secretary of the State Election Board for access to Oklahoma's private voter information.

item.title: Classen drive closes in Midtown; New development under construction
item.description: Construction has started in Midtown on a new project, and you may have noticed that Classen Drive is now closed. That will be a permanent closure to make way for The Eddie, a new development now under construction.

item.title: Alan Armstrong focused on energy infrastructure in new Senate role
item.description: Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt has appointed energy executive Alan Armstrong to the U.S. Senate, replacing Markwayne Mullin.

item.title: Woman helps mothers with babies in NICU after loss of her son to rare disease
item.description: On September 21, 2023, the family made their way to the hospital to welcome baby Jack. It turned into a day that changed the family's life forever.

item.title: KFOR Investigation reveals former Fairview City Manager accused of embezzlement
item.description: KFOR is investigating an allegation of embezzlement against the former city manager of Fairview, Oklahoma involving an expensive piece of ground-clearing equipment.
